verses.1: And it shall be, when you enter into the land that Jehovah your God gives to you as a inheritance, and you possess it and dwell in it.
verses.2: And you shall take from the beginning every fruit of the earth that You will bring from your land. It is what Jehovah your God has given you. You shall put them in baskets, and then go to the place that Jehovah your God has chosen for you to dwell in.
verses.3: And you came before the priest who would be there in those days, and you said to him, “I have reported today to the LORD your God that I have come to the land that the LORD has blessed for our ancestors, so that we may inherit it.”
verses.4: And the priest took the ten commandments from your hand, and placed them before the altar of the LORD your God.
verses.5: And I answered and said before the LORD your God, “Arami, my father died. He went down to Egypt and lived there in great poverty. But there he became a great and powerful nation.”
verses.6: The Egyptians attacked us, treated us badly, and forced us to carry heavy labor.
verses.7: And we cried out to the LORD, our God. The LORD heard our voices. He saw our hardships and our toil. He also saw our suffering.
verses.8: And Jehovah brought us out of Egypt with great strength and by a strong arm. He did this through great hardships and difficult conditions.
verses.9: And they brought us to this place. They gave us this land: a land full of milk and honey.
verses.10: And now, I bring forth the first fruits of the land that Jehovah has given me. I will place them before Jehovah your God. I will bow down in worship before Jehovah your God.
verses.11: And you shall rejoice in all the good that Jehovah your God has given you, and for your house. You, along with Leah and Gad, who are among your people.
verses.12: For you will do all your work during the third year of your reign. You will give it to the Levites to cultivate the land, and they will eat from its fruits.
verses.13: And you said before the LORD your God, in the holy place within the house: “I will give them to the Levites and to the Gershomites as a portion of your law. I have not violated any of your commands, nor have I forgotten them.”
verses.14: I have not eaten from it, nor have I drunk from it in its dirty state. I have not given anything from it to those who are dead. I have obeyed all your commands, just as you commanded me.
verses.15: I shall look down from heaven upon your holiness, and I will bless your people, Israel, and the land that you have given us, just as you promised to our ancestors. It is a land of milk and honey.
verses.16: Today, Jehovah your God commands you to obey these laws and regulations. You have kept them with all your heart and soul.
verses.17: Today, Jehovah said to you: “Be my God. Walk in His ways, and keep His laws, commands, and judgments. And listen to His voice.”
verses.18: And today, Jehovah, who has spoken to you, will make him a people who obey His words and keep all His commandments.
verses.19: And by your power, all the nations who have done these things—for their own sake and for their glory, and to make you a holy people to Jehovah your God, as it is written.
